baseEdit.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Edit target: the supplied image is the user-selected Option B of the fictional adult female visual-novel character 飘 (Piao).
Requested change: add a PAIR OF VERY SHALLOW NATURAL CHEEK DIMPLES, one on EACH cheek just lateral to the mouth corners. They should be tiny soft skin indentations that appear subtly with her existing gentle closed-mouth smile. Both dimples should be perceptible at portrait viewing size while remaining understated and plausible; the farther cheek's dimple follows facial perspective. Render with very soft local cheek shading, not dark dots, moles, punctures, freckles, scars, makeup or deep creases. No exaggerated grin.
Everything else is invariant: preserve the same Option B face, eyes, nose, lips and face proportions, black low ponytail and side-swept fringe, tiny gold ear studs, white short-sleeve collared shirt with black piping, black trousers, red string wrist bracelet, standing pose with one hand gently holding the opposite wrist, hands/fingers, framing, original head position, lighting and semi-realistic painted style. Do not redesign or beautify into another person; do not change clothes, hairstyle, body, apparent adult age, or composition.
Keep the 1024x1536 vertical head-to-mid-thigh portrait, top-of-hair clearance and original canvas composition. TRUE transparent background, preserve original alpha and hair edges. No backdrop, smoke, glow, checkerboard, text, watermark, collage or additional characters. One complete sprite.

entries.label: 微笑
entries.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one transparent visual-novel character sprite variation of 飘 (Piao). Input image: the approved Option B shallow-dimple base sprite, the ONLY identity, clothing, camera and rendering reference. Modify this image rather than redesigning the character.
Preserve the SAME fictional adult woman's identity and adult proportions: soft oval face, small rounded chin, delicate nose, natural lips, dark almond eyes, black low ponytail with the same side-swept fringe and loose cheek strands, tiny gold ear studs. Preserve the PAIR OF SHALLOW NATURAL DIMPLES, one on EACH cheek beside the mouth, subtly visible when smiling and naturally faint when the mouth is neutral. Dimples are soft skin depressions, never dots, scars, freckles or deep holes.
Keep exactly the same white short-sleeve collared shirt with restrained black piping, black straight-cut trousers with original waistband and button, and slim red string bracelet on the original wrist. No new accessories or props.
Match the same premium semi-realistic hand-painted rendering, natural skin and cloth textures, soft neutral lighting, original head position and portrait scale. 1024x1536 vertical portrait, entire head to mid-thigh, clear margins above hair and around the arms. Full hands must fit within the canvas.
Original pose: hands low in front, one non-bracelet hand gently holding the opposite wrist, bracelet on the relaxed wrist. Keep that pose for expression-only variants.
One single sprite; TRUE transparent background with original clean hair and sleeve alpha. Do not reproduce black or light preview backdrops. No smoke, halo, floor, scenery, text, watermark, grid or collage. Do not change face anatomy, apparent age, hair, clothing or lighting. Anatomically believable fingers.
Variation: Change ONLY the facial expression: a warmer closed-mouth smile with visibly raised lip corners and softened eyes, gently lifted cheeks. Both shallow dimples become a little more readable while remaining soft and natural. No teeth, laughter or exaggerated indentations. Keep the entire original pose and hand placement.
